title: Whole Part of Square Roots
statement:
For a non-negative integer `v`, its whole square root is the largest integer `r` with `r * r <= v`. You are given `T` numbers. Find the whole square root of each and print the sum of all of them.

## Input
The first line contains `T`. The second line contains `T` integers.

## Output
Print the sum of the whole square roots of all `T` numbers.

## Constraints
- `1 <= T <= 10000`
- `0 <= v <= 10^18`
